purpose: Measure whether Buddy can recognize how AI can help with arbitrary legitimate work and deliver a verified useful outcome.
failure_rule: A failed subtask lowers the relevant score and creates a recovery item; it does not terminate evaluation of the overall task unless a safety or authorization gate requires stopping.
restart_rule: On a new session, restore unfinished tasks, checkpoints, failure history, benchmark history, and next strategies before selecting new work.
mastery_rule: Do not claim universal task mastery. Publish domain-specific scores, confidence, limitations, and evidence.
continuous_advancement: After a task class reaches its target score, generate harder variants, adversarial cases, efficiency targets, and professional-quality comparisons.
